source: claude/goal-projects working tree (uncommitted at capture time; the committed branch contains the same files), Chromium 1.64.1 headless with SwiftShader WebGL, reduced motion
mode: isolated example server on 127.0.0.1:3171 (OUR_CASTLE_ENV_FILE=none, empty PayPal/AI/Channel3/AG Studio keys, temporary data directory) and the Playwright example web server on 3111; synthetic House of Alder $300 goal; no provider, model, merchant or payment call
procedure: Review captures: reset the example household, POST /api/setup, then PUT /api/goal with the example goal, projectKind and a reported starting amount that sets the stage; load /, select the project marker by keyboard, press View > Zoom in three times, nudge the viewport once so the headless compositor shows the redraw, and screenshot .realm-map. The plan capture comes from the committed browser test.
limits: Example-mode pictures for visual review, not family playtest observations, physical-device, GPU or performance evidence. Stages set through the reported starting amount, not contributions (the browser tests cover contributions and refunds).
